btn_install.ga: Suiteáil an aip mura bhfuil sí agat
btn_install.en: Install the app if you don't have it

hint_1.ga: Nuair a scanann tú an QR ar scáileán RayTok an fhóin eile, tagann tú anseo. Má tá an aip suiteáilte osclaíonn sí láithreach; mura bhfuil, suiteáil í leis an gcnaipe thuas agus scan an QR arís.
hint_1.en: Scanning the QR on the other phone's RayTok screen brings you here. If the app is installed it opens right away; if not, install it with the button above and scan the QR again.

hint_2.ga: Caithfidh an dá fhón a bheith ar an Wi-Fi céanna (nó ar theophointe duine acu). Ní gá idirlíon.
hint_2.en: Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi (or one phone's hotspot). No internet needed.

hint_3.ga: Is iad na sonraí naisc sa bharra seoltaí seoladh áitiúil an fhóin sin agus cód fíoraithe aonuaire. Ní chiallaíonn siad tada taobh amuigh den Wi-Fi sin agus stopann siad ag obair chomh luath is a dhúnann an t-óstach an scáileán.
hint_3.en: The connection info in the address bar is that phone's local address and a one-time verification code. It means nothing unless you're on the same Wi-Fi, and it stops working as soon as the host closes the screen.

msg_no_info.ga: Níl aon sonraí naisc sa nasc seo. Scan an QR ar an scáileán eile arís, le do thoil.
msg_no_info.en: This link has no connection info. Please scan the QR on the other screen again.

msg_android.ga: Má tá an aip suiteáilte osclóidh sí láithreach. Mura n-osclaíonn, tapáil an cnaipe thíos.
msg_android.en: If the app is installed it will open right away. If not, tap the button below.

msg_ios.ga: Is don aip RayTok Android an nasc seo. Níl aip iPhone ann fós.
msg_ios.en: This link is for the Android RayTok app. There is no iPhone app yet.
